signals.name: Nathan Benaich
signals.latest_title: Post on AI solving long-unsolved math problems / State of AI Report 2026 teaser
signals.summary: Commented that a solution to a problem unsolved for 200 years is better today than in 10 more years, and hinted at more to say in the upcoming State of AI Report 2026 (launch meetup Oct 8 in SF).
signals.connection: Ties to the frontier AI capability story and the Anthropic IPO and AI-governance news, since the State of AI report will likely frame the state of the field.

signals.name: Michael Burry
signals.summary: Reports big action in his big shorts as his research progresses, plus a few new buys, and is moving up his timelines. Earlier in the week he compared AI capex to past capital-cycle bubbles and flagged roughly $900B of off-balance-sheet AI commitments at Alphabet.
signals.connection: A bearish counterpoint to the Anthropic $2T+ IPO valuation leak and to AI-capex enthusiasm, at a time of multi-decade-high Treasury yields after the Fed hike.

signals.name: Ben Thompson
signals.latest_title: OpenAI Dev Day, Dot and OpenAI's Product Transition, Sign In With ChatGPT
signals.summary: Says OpenAI's Dev Day showed a confusing product with more vision than it first appears. Earlier pieces argued agents are the ultimate Aggregators that reduce apps to a means, and that Meta should chase consumer agents rather than the enterprise.
signals.connection: Frames the platform competition among AI labs behind the Anthropic IPO valuation and the frontier-lab safety pledge.

signals.name: Paul Graham
signals.latest_title: Posts on college and startups, and on .com vs .ai domains
signals.summary: Warned founders not to start a startup expecting to go to college, or back, afterward, because the two paths are incompatible. Also said a better .com is always available for about $5k than the .ai name a startup is using.
signals.connection: Loosely related to AI-startup culture and the frenzy around AI valuations.

signals.name: Packy McCormick
signals.summary: A deep dive on Airbound and the future of personal flight. Also published Weekly Dose of Optimism #212 (Vironexis, Solcoa, Terraform, Joby, Meta VR glasses) and a piece on the future of education.
signals.connection: Fits the Applied Tech & Industry and Frontier Tech themes.

signals.name: CJ Gustafson
signals.latest_title: Why Aren't Founders and Boards More Pissed About Day 1 IPO Pops?
signals.summary: Argues founders and boards should be angrier about large first-day IPO pops, which leave money on the table.
signals.connection: Relevant to the Anthropic IPO prospectus leak and how a mega-IPO might be priced.

signals.name: Lenny Rachitsky
signals.latest_title: All of the Lenny & Friends Summit talks are now online!
signals.summary: Published all the summit talks with reflections and takeaways. His How I AI episode says Opus 5.5 brought him back to Claude after months away, includes an Opus 5.5 vs GPT-6 Sol benchmark, and covers Jev, a tool that returns type-safe structured values as a cheap classification layer.
signals.connection: Shows real-world practitioner momentum for Anthropic's models, in line with the IPO valuation story.
